newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Elbit Q3 net $3.567 mln vs $3.31 mln.
newsitem.headline: Elbit Q3 net $3.567 mln vs $3.31 mln.

text.p: Israel's Elbit Ltd, an electronics maker, reported third-quarter net profit of $3.567 million, compared with $3.310 million in the year-earlier period.

The company said it published only summary results because it expects to have completed its break-up into three separate companies by the end of November. At that time, it will publish separate and full results for the three.
Elbit said net earnings for the nine months fell to $8.578 million from $14.313 million a year earlier. The company provided no other figures.
Elbit declared a third-quarter dividend of $0.06 a share payable on January 20, 1997.

Elbit said it was waiting for final approvals from regulatory authorities after shareholders on November 6 agreed to a plan by management to split the company into three publicly traded concerns specialising in medical electronics, defence electronics and communications.
Elbit, which is also traded on Nasdaq, said it expected all the approvals to be completed by the end of November.
